title: IRAN'S FALLEN EAGLE RETURNS HOME: MARTYR PILOT WHO STRUCK US BASE IN DARING SU-24 MISSION
text:
IRAN'S FALLEN EAGLE RETURNS HOME: MARTYR PILOT WHO STRUCK US BASE IN DARING SU-24 MISSION"

"**SHIRAZ, Iran** – The body of Second Brigadier General Majid Kazemi, the Su-24 fighter pilot who led a daring retaliatory strike against a major US military installation, arrived in his hometown of Shiraz on Thursday as thousands gathered to honor the fallen hero."

"The funeral procession began at Shahid Doran Air Base, with senior military officials and comrades paying tribute to the pilot whose identity was only confirmed this week through DNA testing after months of uncertainty. His body will be carried through Imam Hossein Square on Friday following weekly prayers, as the people of Shiraz prepare to bid a final farewell to one of their own."

"**A Mission of Retaliation**"

"On March 2, Kazemi was among the pilots of two Iranian Air Force Su-24 bombers that took off from Shahid Doran Air Base in response to what Iran described as "savage and treacherous attacks" by US and Israeli forces. The operation followed a large-scale US-Israeli military campaign against Iran that began on February 28 after the assassination of then-Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei and several senior commanders."

"**Penetrating Advanced Defenses**"

"The Iranian Army statement detailed how Kazemi and his fellow pilots penetrated the enemy's advanced surveillance systems and multiple radar positions before carrying out a bombing raid on the US-operated Al Udeid Air Base in Qatar. The strike caused heavy damage to the facility. Iran's retaliatory operations ultimately included 100 waves of attacks against American and Israeli positions across the region."

"**A Hero's Final Flight**"

"While returning from the mission, the two Su-24 aircraft were struck by enemy air defense systems over the Persian Gulf. Kazemi was martyred alongside three crewmates, whose fate remains unknown as search efforts continue."

"Army Chief praised Kazemi as a "true hero" who embodied a generation of warriors who pledged to become the shield of their nation's skies. His body was transferred from Shahid Lashgari Air Base in Tehran before arriving in Shiraz for burial."

""Martyrdom is not the end of a great man's journey; it is the beginning of his immortality," read a tribute published by Tehran Times. "Nations endure because of men like him.
